steps.message:
# RL training run diagnosis

Review the staged post-training experiment and determine whether it is healthy
or unhealthy. Treat the workspace as a historical snapshot: inspect its source,
effective configuration, launch scripts, data processing, reward logic, logs,
tracked metrics, and frozen evaluation evidence. Do not assume that an unusual
setting or implementation is causal without connecting it to observed behavior.

Use held-out evaluation evidence together with rollout, truncation, runtime,
optimization, and training signals. Training reward alone does not establish
held-out health. A truncated log is not by itself proof of a defect.

Do not launch a full training run, use the network, or modify the historical
snapshot. The dataset, held-out set, model, training-step budget, and evaluation
interval are fixed.

## Deliverable

Write one concise UTF-8 diagnosis to:

```text
$AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS/agent_answer.md
```

State the verdict, identify the concrete root cause or causes, and explain the
causal chain using specific workspace evidence. Distinguish root causes from
symptoms. Do not propose or implement a fix, and do not write other deliverable
files.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# GRPO | Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct | FSDP + vLLM, one GPU | GSM8K
# verls GSM8K GRPO quickstart scaled to a single GPU. Reward: verls built-in GSM8K
# rule (last "#### N" must equal the gold answer), scored by the DAPO reward manager
# with the overlong penalty disabled.
set -xeuo pipefail

W=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
cd "$W"

MODEL_PATH=${MODEL_PATH:-$W/models/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct}
TRAIN_FILE=${TRAIN_FILE:-$W/data/gsm8k/train.parquet}
VAL_FILE=${VAL_FILE:-$W/data/gsm8k/test.parquet}
LOG_DIR=${LOG_DIR:-$W/outputs/run}
NGPUS_PER_NODE=${NGPUS_PER_NODE:-1}
TOTAL_STEPS=${TOTAL_STEPS:-100}
TEST_FREQ=${TEST_FREQ:-10}
SEED=${SEED:-42}

TRAIN_BATCH_SIZE=128         # prompts per step
ROLLOUT_N=8                  # responses per prompt (GRPO group size)
PPO_MINI_BATCH_SIZE=32       # 4 optimizer steps per training step
MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH=512
MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH=512
ACTOR_LR=2e-6
KL_LOSS_COEF=0.001
ADAM_EPS=0.001               # AdamW eps raised from 1e-8: bf16 second-moment estimates underflow and give spiky updates

PROJECT_NAME=${PROJECT_NAME:-grpo_gsm8k}
EXPERIMENT_NAME=${EXPERIMENT_NAME:-qwen2_5_0_5b_gsm8k_grpo}

if [ ! -f "$MODEL_PATH/config.json" ]; then
    echo "model not found at $MODEL_PATH" >&2; exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "$TRAIN_FILE" ] || [ ! -f "$VAL_FILE" ]; then
    python3 examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k.py --local_dataset_path "$W/data/raw/gsm8k" --local_save_dir "$(dirname "$TRAIN_FILE")"
fi

mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
export PYTHONPATH="$W${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
export WANDB_MODE=${WANDB_MODE:-offline}
export WANDB_DIR=${WANDB_DIR:-$LOG_DIR}
export VERL_FILE_LOGGER_PATH="$LOG_DIR/metrics.jsonl"
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false

DATA=(
    algorithm.adv_estimator=grpo
    algorithm.use_kl_in_reward=False
    data.train_files="$TRAIN_FILE"
    data.val_files="$VAL_FILE"
    data.train_batch_size=$TRAIN_BATCH_SIZE
    data.max_prompt_length=$MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH
    data.max_response_length=$MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH
    data.filter_overlong_prompts=True
    data.truncation=error
    data.seed=$SEED
    data.dataloader_num_workers=0
)
MODEL=(
    actor_rollout_ref.model.path="$MODEL_PATH"
    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True
    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True
)
ACTOR=(
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=$ACTOR_LR
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.override_optimizer_config={eps:$ADAM_EPS}
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=$PPO_MINI_BATCH_SIZE
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=True
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu=24576
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=True
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=$KL_LOSS_COEF
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_type=low_var_kl
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.entropy_coeff=0
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.loss_agg_mode=token-mean
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.data_loader_seed=$SEED
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.param_offload=False
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.optimizer_offload=False
)
ROLLOUT=(
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=1
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.4
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=$ROLLOUT_N
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature=1.0
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.top_p=1.0
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.top_k=-1
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.seed=$SEED
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.agent.num_workers=1
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=24576
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.n=1
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.do_sample=False
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=24576
)
REWARD=(
    reward.reward_manager.name=dapo
    reward.num_workers=1
    +reward.reward_kwargs.overlong_buffer_cfg.enable=False
    +reward.reward_kwargs.overlong_buffer_cfg.len=128
    +reward.reward_kwargs.overlong_buffer_cfg.penalty_factor=1.0
    +reward.reward_kwargs.overlong_buffer_cfg.log=False
    +reward.reward_kwargs.max_resp_len=$MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH
)
TRAINER=(
    trainer.use_v1=False
    trainer.critic_warmup=0
    trainer.logger=[console,wandb,file]
    trainer.project_name=$PROJECT_NAME
    trainer.experiment_name=$EXPERIMENT_NAME
    trainer.n_gpus_per_node=$NGPUS_PER_NODE
    trainer.nnodes=1
    trainer.save_freq=-1
    trainer.test_freq=$TEST_FREQ
    trainer.val_before_train=True
    trainer.total_epochs=15
    trainer.total_training_steps=$TOTAL_STEPS
    trainer.resume_mode=disable
    trainer.rollout_data_dir="$LOG_DIR/rollouts"
    trainer.validation_data_dir="$LOG_DIR/val_generations"
)

# One GPU, a few CPUs: Ray must not size itself from the whole host.
RAY=(
    ray_kwargs.ray_init.num_cpus=4
    +ray_kwargs.ray_init.object_store_memory=6000000000
)

python3 -m verl.trainer.main_ppo \
    "${DATA[@]}" "${MODEL[@]}" "${ACTOR[@]}" "${ROLLOUT[@]}" "${REWARD[@]}" "${TRAINER[@]}" "${RAY[@]}" "$@" \
    2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/train.log"

"""
Preprocess the GSM8k dataset to parquet format
"""

import argparse
import os
import re

import datasets

from verl.utils.hdfs_io import copy, makedirs


def extract_solution(solution_str):
    solution = re.search("#### (\\-?[0-9\\.\\,]+)", solution_str)
    assert solution is not None
    final_solution = solution.group(0)
    final_solution = final_solution.split("#### ")[1].replace(",", "")
    return final_solution


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--local_dir", default=None, help="The save directory for the preprocessed dataset.")
    parser.add_argument("--hdfs_dir", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--local_dataset_path", default=None, help="The local path to the raw dataset, if it exists.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--local_save_dir", default="~/data/gsm8k", help="The save directory for the preprocessed dataset."
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()
    local_dataset_path = args.local_dataset_path

    data_source = "openai/gsm8k"

    if local_dataset_path is not None:
        dataset = datasets.load_dataset(local_dataset_path, "main")
    else:
        dataset = datasets.load_dataset(data_source, "main")

    train_dataset = dataset["train"]
    test_dataset = dataset["test"]

    instruction_following = 'Let\'s think step by step and output the final answer after "####".'

    # add a row to each data item that represents a unique id
    def make_map_fn(split):
        def process_fn(example, idx):
            question_raw = example.pop("question")

            question = question_raw + " " + instruction_following

            answer_raw = example.pop("answer")
            solution = extract_solution(answer_raw)
            data = {
                "data_source": data_source,
                "prompt": [
                    {
                        "role": "user",
                        "content": question,
                    }
                ],
                "ability": "math",
                "reward_model": {"style": "rule", "ground_truth": solution},
                "extra_info": {
                    "split": split,
                    "index": idx,
                    "answer": answer_raw,
                    "question": question_raw,
                },
            }
            return data

        return process_fn

    train_dataset = train_dataset.map(function=make_map_fn("train"), with_indices=True)
    test_dataset = test_dataset.map(function=make_map_fn("test"), with_indices=True)

    hdfs_dir = args.hdfs_dir
    local_save_dir = args.local_dir
    if local_save_dir is not None:
        print("Warning: Argument 'local_dir' is deprecated. Please use 'local_save_dir' instead.")
    else:
        local_save_dir = args.local_save_dir

    train_dataset.to_parquet(os.path.join(local_save_dir, "train.parquet"))
    test_dataset.to_parquet(os.path.join(local_save_dir, "test.parquet"))

    if hdfs_dir is not None:
        makedirs(hdfs_dir)

        copy(src=local_save_dir, dst=hdfs_dir)

That's weird: "Warning: Argument 'local_dir' is deprecated. Please use 'local_save_dir' instead." but then `local_save_dir = args.local_dir` — wait:

So there's a subtree swap: `local_dir` and `local_save_dir` are swapped. The run script calls with `--local_save_dir "$(dirname "$TRAIN_FILE")"` = `$W/data/gsm8k`. import re

_SOLUTION_CLIP_CHARS = 300


def extract_solution(solution_str, method="strict"):
    assert method in ["strict", "flexible"]

    # Optimization: Regular expression matching on very long strings can be slow.
    # For math problems, the final answer is usually at the end.
    # We only match on the last 300 characters, which is a safe approximation for 300 tokens.
    if len(solution_str) > _SOLUTION_CLIP_CHARS:
        solution_str = solution_str[-_SOLUTION_CLIP_CHARS:]

    if method == "strict":
        # this also tests the formatting of the model
        solutions = re.findall("#### (\\-?[0-9\\.\\,]+)", solution_str)
        if len(solutions) == 0:
            final_answer = None
        else:
            # take the last solution
            final_answer = solutions[-1].replace(",", "").replace("$", "")
    elif method == "flexible":
        answer = re.findall("(\\-?[0-9\\.\\,]+)", solution_str)
        final_answer = None
        if len(answer) == 0:
            # no reward is there is no answer
            pass
        else:
            invalid_str = ["", "."]
            # find the last number that is not '.'
            for final_answer in reversed(answer):
                if final_answer not in invalid_str:
                    break
    return final_answer


def compute_score(solution_str, ground_truth, method="strict", format_score=0.0, score=1.0):
    """The scoring function for GSM8k.

    Reference: Trung, Luong, et al. "Reft: Reasoning with reinforced fine-tuning." Proceedings of the 62nd Annual
    Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers). 2024.

    Args:
        solution_str: the solution text
        ground_truth: the ground truth
        method: the method to extract the solution, choices are 'strict' and 'flexible'
        format_score: the score for the format
        score: the score for the correct answer
    """
    answer = extract_solution(solution_str=solution_str, method=method)
    if answer is None:
        return 0
    else:
        if answer == ground_truth:
            return score
        else:
            return format_score

Hmm, but wait — actually, there's a subtle bug here: in "strict" mode, upstream takes `solutions[-1]` — the LAST "#### N" match. The answer "#### N" is typically at the end of the response... but what if the model, early in RL training, learns to output "#### N" and then keep rambling? Then clipping would lose the answer.

from collections import defaultdict

import torch

from verl import DataProto
from verl.utils.reward_score import default_compute_score
from verl.workers.reward_manager import register
from verl.workers.reward_manager.abstract import AbstractRewardManager


@register("dapo")
class DAPORewardManager(AbstractRewardManager):
    """The reward manager."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        tokenizer,
        num_examine,
        compute_score=None,
        reward_fn_key="data_source",
        max_resp_len=None,
        overlong_buffer_cfg=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.num_examine = num_examine  # the number of batches of decoded responses to print to the console
        self.compute_score = compute_score or default_compute_score
        self.reward_fn_key = reward_fn_key
        self.overlong_buffer_cfg = overlong_buffer_cfg
        self.max_resp_len = max_resp_len

        if self.overlong_buffer_cfg is not None and self.overlong_buffer_cfg.enable:
            assert self.max_resp_len is not None, (
                f"max_resp_len must be provided if {overlong_buffer_cfg=}, but got None"
            )
            assert self.max_resp_len >= self.overlong_buffer_cfg.len, (
                "max_resp_len must be larger than overlong_buffer.len"
            )
            assert self.overlong_buffer_cfg.len > 0, (
                "overlong_buffer.len must be positive when overlong penalty is enabled,"
                f"but got {self.overlong_buffer_cfg.len}."
                "To disable the overlong penalty, set overlong_buffer.enable = False"
            )

    def __call__(self, data: DataProto, return_dict: bool = False):
        """We will expand this function gradually based on the available datasets"""

        # If there is rm score, we directly return rm score. Otherwise, we compute via rm_score_fn
        reward_from_rm_scores = self._extract_reward_from_rm_scores(data, return_dict)
        if reward_from_rm_scores is not None:
            return reward_from_rm_scores

        reward_tensor = torch.zeros_like(data.batch["responses"], dtype=torch.float32)
        reward_extra_info = defaultdict(list)

        already_print_data_sources = {}

        for i in range(len(data)):
            data_item = data[i]  # DataProtoItem

            prompt_ids = data_item.batch["prompts"]

            prompt_length = prompt_ids.shape[-1]

            valid_prompt_length = data_item.batch["attention_mask"][:prompt_length].sum()
            valid_prompt_ids = prompt_ids[-valid_prompt_length:]

            response_ids = data_item.batch["responses"]
            valid_response_length = data_item.batch["attention_mask"][prompt_length:].sum()
            valid_response_ids = response_ids[:valid_response_length]

            # decode
            prompt_str = self.tokenizer.decode(valid_prompt_ids, skip_special_tokens=True)
            response_str = self.tokenizer.decode(valid_response_ids, skip_special_tokens=True)
            eos_token = self.tokenizer.eos_token
            if response_str.endswith(eos_token):
                response_str = response_str[: -len(eos_token)]

            ground_truth = data_item.non_tensor_batch["reward_model"]["ground_truth"]

            data_source = data_item.non_tensor_batch[self.reward_fn_key]

            extra_info = data_item.non_tensor_batch.get("extra_info", {})

            rollout_reward_scores = data_item.non_tensor_batch.get("reward_scores", {})

            extra_info["rollout_reward_scores"] = rollout_reward_scores

            result = self.compute_score(
                data_source=data_source,
                solution_str=response_str,
                ground_truth=ground_truth,
                extra_info=extra_info,
            )

            score: float
            if isinstance(result, dict):
                score = result["score"]
                # Store the information including original reward
                for key, value in result.items():
                    reward_extra_info[key].append(value)
            else:
                score = result
                reward_extra_info["acc"].append(score)

            reward = score

            if self.overlong_buffer_cfg is not None and self.overlong_buffer_cfg.enable:
                overlong_buffer_len = self.overlong_buffer_cfg.len
                expected_len = self.max_resp_len - overlong_buffer_len
                exceed_len = valid_response_length - expected_len
                overlong_penalty_factor = self.overlong_buffer_cfg.penalty_factor
                overlong_reward = min(-exceed_len / overlong_buffer_len * overlong_penalty_factor, 0)
                reward += overlong_reward
                if self.overlong_buffer_cfg.log:
                    reward_extra_info["overlong_reward"].append(overlong_reward)
                    reward_extra_info["overlong"].append(overlong_reward < 0)

            reward_tensor[i, valid_response_length - 1] = reward

            if data_source not in already_print_data_sources:
                already_print_data_sources[data_source] = 0

            if already_print_data_sources[data_source] < self.num_examine:
                already_print_data_sources[data_source] += 1
                print("[prompt]", prompt_str)
                print("[response]", response_str)
                print("[ground_truth]", ground_truth)
                if isinstance(result, dict):
                    for key, value in result.items():
                        print(f"[{key}]", value)
                else:
                    print("[score]", score)

        if return_dict:
            return {
                "reward_tensor": reward_tensor,
                "reward_extra_info": reward_extra_info,
            }
        else:
            return reward_tensor

"""
Core functions to implement PPO algorithms.
The function implemented in this file should be used by trainer with different distributed strategies to
implement PPO-like algorithms.
"""

__all__ = ["register_adv_est", "get_adv_estimator_fn", "AdvantageEstimator"]

from collections import defaultdict
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Callable, Optional

import numpy as np
import torch
from omegaconf import DictConfig

import verl.utils.torch_functional as verl_F
from verl.trainer.config import AlgoConfig
from verl.utils import as_torch_index, group_mean_std
from verl.utils.import_utils import deprecated
from verl.workers.config import ActorConfig

PolicyLossFn = Callable[
    [
        torch.Tensor,  # old_log_prob
        torch.Tensor,  # log_prob
        torch.Tensor,  # advantages
        torch.Tensor,  # response_mask
        str,  # loss_agg_mode
        Optional[DictConfig | ActorConfig],  # config
        torch.Tensor | None,  # rollout_log_probs
    ],
    tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]],
]

POLICY_LOSS_REGISTRY: dict[str, PolicyLossFn] = {}


def register_policy_loss(name: str) -> Callable[[PolicyLossFn], PolicyLossFn]:
    """Register a policy loss function with the given name.

    Args:
        name (str): The name to register the policy loss function under.

    Returns:
        function: Decorator function that registers the policy loss function.
    """

    def decorator(func: PolicyLossFn) -> PolicyLossFn:
        POLICY_LOSS_REGISTRY[name] = func
        return func

    return decorator


def get_policy_loss_fn(name):
    """Get the policy loss with a given name.

    Args:
        name: `(str)`
            The name of the policy loss.

    Returns:
        `(callable)`: The policy loss function.
    """
    loss_name = name
    if loss_name not in POLICY_LOSS_REGISTRY:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Unsupported loss mode: {loss_name}. Supported modes are: {list(POLICY_LOSS_REGISTRY.keys())}"
        )
    return POLICY_LOSS_REGISTRY[loss_name]


class AdvantageEstimator(str, Enum):

@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GRPO)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("grpo")
def compute_grpo_outcome_advantage(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    index: np.ndarray,
    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """
    Compute advantage for GRPO, operating only on Outcome reward
    (with only one scalar reward for each response).

    Args:
        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape is (bs, response_length)
        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape is (bs, response_length)
        index: `(np.ndarray)`
            index array for grouping
        epsilon: `(float)`
            small value to avoid division by zero
        norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: `(bool)`
            whether to scale the GRPO advantage
        config: `(Optional[AlgoConfig])`
            algorithm configuration object

    Note:
        If norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo is True, the advantage is scaled by the std, as in the original GRPO.
        If False, the advantage is not scaled, as in Dr.GRPO (https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783).

    Returns:
        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape is (bs, response_length)
        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape is (bs, response_length)
    """
    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)

    id2score = defaultdict(list)
    id2mean = {}
    id2std = {}

    with torch.no_grad():
        bsz = scores.shape[0]
        for i in range(bsz):
            id2score[index[i]].append(scores[i])
        for idx in id2score:
            if len(id2score[idx]) == 1:
                id2mean[idx] = torch.tensor(0.0)
                id2std[idx] = torch.tensor(1.0)
            elif len(id2score[idx]) > 1:
                scores_tensor = torch.stack(id2score[idx])
                id2mean[idx] = torch.mean(scores_tensor)
                id2std[idx] = torch.std(scores_tensor)
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"no score in prompt index: {idx}")
        for i in range(bsz):
            if norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo:
                scores[i] = (scores[i] - id2mean[index[i]]) / (id2std[index[i]] + epsilon)
            else:
                scores[i] = scores[i] - id2mean[index[i]]
        scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask

    return scores, scores


@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GRPO_VECTORIZED)
def compute_grpo_vectorized_outcome_advantage(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    index: np.ndarray,
    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """
    Vectorized GRPO（outcome-only）:
      For each group g:
      a_i = \\frac{r_i - \\mu_g}{\\sigma_g} (or without dividing by \\sigma_g),
      then broadcast the scalar across the token dimension (multiplied by response_mask).。
    """
    with torch.no_grad():
        scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
        g = as_torch_index(index, device=scores.device)
        mean_g, std_g, _ = group_mean_std(scores, g, eps=0.0, device=scores.device)
        if norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo:
            scalars = (scores - mean_g[g]) / (std_g[g] + epsilon)
        else:
            scalars = scores - mean_g[g]
        advantages = scalars.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
        return advantages, advantages

        advantages: (bs, response_length)

    """

    if config is not None and non_tensor_batch is not None and batch is not None:

            "component keys returned by compute_score (e.g. ['format_reward', 'accuracy_reward'])."
        )
        device = token_level_rewards.device
        prompt_length = batch["prompts"].size(1)

@deprecated("verl.trainer.ppo.core_algos.compute_policy_loss_vanilla")
def compute_policy_loss(
    old_log_prob,
    log_prob,
    advantages,
    response_mask,
    cliprange=None,
    cliprange_low=None,
    cliprange_high=None,
    clip_ratio_c=3.0,
    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
):
    """
    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for PPO.

    Adapted from
    https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/main/trl/trainer/ppo_trainer.py#L1122

    Args:
        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        advantages (torch.Tensor):
            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        cliprange (float, optional):
            Clipping parameter ε for standard PPO. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
            Defaults to None (must be provided).
        cliprange_low (float, optional):
            Lower clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
        cliprange_high (float, optional):
            Upper clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
        clip_ratio_c (float, optional):
            Lower bound of the ratio for dual-clip PPO. See https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.09729.
            Defaults to 3.0.
        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
    """
    assert clip_ratio_c > 1.0, (
        "The lower bound of the clip_ratio_c for dual-clip PPO should be greater than 1.0,"
        + f" but get the value: {clip_ratio_c}."
    )

    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)

    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
    if cliprange_low is None:
        cliprange_low = cliprange
    if cliprange_high is None:
        cliprange_high = cliprange
    pg_losses2 = -advantages * torch.clamp(
        ratio, 1 - cliprange_low, 1 + cliprange_high
    )  # - clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A
    clip_pg_losses1 = torch.maximum(
        pg_losses1, pg_losses2
    )  # max(-ratio * A, -clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A)
    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean(torch.gt(pg_losses2, pg_losses1).float(), response_mask)

    pg_losses3 = -advantages * clip_ratio_c
    clip_pg_losses2 = torch.min(pg_losses3, clip_pg_losses1)
    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean(
        torch.gt(clip_pg_losses1, pg_losses3) * (advantages < 0).float(), response_mask
    )

    pg_losses = torch.where(advantages < 0, clip_pg_losses2, clip_pg_losses1)
    pg_loss = agg_loss(loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode)

    return pg_loss, pg_clipfrac, ppo_kl, pg_clipfrac_lower

    """

    https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/main/trl/trainer/ppo_trainer.py#L1122

        rollout_log_probs: `(torch.Tensor)`:

    """

    assert config is not None
    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig)
    clip_ratio = config.clip_ratio  # Clipping parameter ε for standard PPO. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
    clip_ratio_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else clip_ratio
    clip_ratio_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else clip_ratio

        "clip_ratio_c", 3.0

    cliprange_low = clip_ratio_low
    cliprange_high = clip_ratio_high

        "The lower bound of the clip_ratio_c for dual-clip PPO should be greater than 1.0,"
        + f" but get the value: {clip_ratio_c}."
    )

    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)

    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
    if cliprange_low is None:
        cliprange_low = cliprange
    if cliprange_high is None:
        cliprange_high = cliprange
    pg_losses2 = -advantages * torch.clamp(
        ratio, 1 - cliprange_low, 1 + cliprange_high
    )  # - clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A
    clip_pg_losses1 = torch.maximum(
        pg_losses1, pg_losses2
    )  # max(-ratio * A, -clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A)
    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean(torch.gt(pg_losses2, pg_losses1).float(), response_mask)

    pg_losses3 = -advantages * clip_ratio_c
    clip_pg_losses2 = torch.min(pg_losses3, clip_pg_losses1)
    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean(
        torch.gt(clip_pg_losses1, pg_losses3) * (advantages < 0).float(), response_mask
    )

    pg_losses = torch.where(advantages < 0, clip_pg_losses2, clip_pg_losses1)

    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights

    pg_loss = agg_loss(
        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
    )

    pg_metrics = {
        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
    }
    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

28	def sft_loss(config: ActorConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
29	    pad_mode = tu.get_non_tensor_data(data=data, key="pad_mode", default=DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING)
30	    dp_size = data["dp_size"]
31	    batch_num_tokens = data["batch_num_tokens"]
32	
33	    log_prob = model_output["log_probs"]
34	
35	    if pad_mode == DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING:
36	        # log_prob and loss mask are nested tensors of shape [bsz, j1]
37	        # for each sample, loss mask shape is [1, prompt_length + response_length]
38	        loss_mask = data["loss_mask"]
39	
40	        log_prob_flatten = log_prob.values()
41	        loss_mask_flatten = loss_mask.values()
42	
43	        # left-shift the loss mask by one token to align with log_prob
44	        loss_mask_flatten = torch.roll(loss_mask_flatten, shifts=-1, dims=0)
45	
46	        # NOTE: loss is averaged over all tokens in the batch across all data parallel groups,
47	        # For FSDP backend, the loss is directly used for backward; while for Megatron backend,
48	        # the loss should be scaled by `num_microbatches` for pp schedule.
49	        loss = -masked_sum(log_prob_flatten, loss_mask_flatten) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
50	    else:
51	        response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)
52	        loss = -masked_sum(log_prob, response_mask) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
53	
54	    return loss, {}

58	    """Computes ppo loss from model output (log_prob, entropy, values, etc. ) and old_log_probs from data."""

67	    config.global_batch_info["global_batch_size"] = data["global_batch_size"]

77	        or config.loss_scale_factor is not None

103	    policy_loss_fn = get_policy_loss_fn(loss_mode)
104	    pg_loss, pg_metrics = policy_loss_fn(

116	    pg_metrics = Metric.from_dict(pg_metrics, aggregation=AggregationType.MEAN)
117	
118	    metrics.update(pg_metrics)

120	    policy_loss = pg_loss

122	    # add entropy loss

124	        entropy_loss = agg_loss(
125	            loss_mat=entropy, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
126	        )
127	        entropy_coeff = config.entropy_coeff
128	        policy_loss -= entropy_coeff * entropy_loss

import torch
from tensordict import TensorDict

from verl.trainer.ppo.core_algos import agg_loss, compute_value_loss, get_policy_loss_fn, kl_penalty
from verl.utils import tensordict_utils as tu
from verl.utils.dataset.dataset_utils import DatasetPadMode
from verl.utils.metric import AggregationType, Metric
from verl.utils.torch_functional import masked_mean, masked_sum
from verl.workers.config import ActorConfig, CriticConfig
from verl.workers.utils.padding import no_padding_2_padding


def sft_loss(config: ActorConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
    pad_mode = tu.get_non_tensor_data(data=data, key="pad_mode", default=DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING)
    dp_size = data["dp_size"]
    batch_num_tokens = data["batch_num_tokens"]

    log_prob = model_output["log_probs"]

    if pad_mode == DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING:
        # log_prob and loss mask are nested tensors of shape [bsz, j1]
        # for each sample, loss mask shape is [1, prompt_length + response_length]
        loss_mask = data["loss_mask"]

        log_prob_flatten = log_prob.values()
        loss_mask_flatten = loss_mask.values()

        # left-shift the loss mask by one token to align with log_prob
        loss_mask_flatten = torch.roll(loss_mask_flatten, shifts=-1, dims=0)

        # NOTE: loss is averaged over all tokens in the batch across all data parallel groups,
        # For FSDP backend, the loss is directly used for backward; while for Megatron backend,
        # the loss should be scaled by `num_microbatches` for pp schedule.
        loss = -masked_sum(log_prob_flatten, loss_mask_flatten) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
    else:
        response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)
        loss = -masked_sum(log_prob, response_mask) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size

    return loss, {}


def ppo_loss(config: ActorConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
    """Computes ppo loss from model output (log_prob, entropy, values, etc. ) and old_log_probs from data."""
    log_prob = no_padding_2_padding(model_output["log_probs"], data)
    entropy = model_output.get("entropy", None)
    if entropy is not None:
        entropy = no_padding_2_padding(entropy, data)

    # global batch info for loss aggregation
    config.global_batch_info["dp_size"] = data["dp_size"]
    config.global_batch_info["batch_num_tokens"] = data["batch_num_tokens"]
    config.global_batch_info["global_batch_size"] = data["global_batch_size"]
    config.global_batch_info["loss_scale_factor"] = config.loss_scale_factor

    # assumes that if any of the global batch info is set, the policy_loss_fn will
    # normalize using dp_size/global_bsz/global_token; in this case, metric aggregation should be SUM
    # to reflect the mean loss over the global batch
    if (
        data["dp_size"] > 1
        or data["batch_num_tokens"] is not None
        or data["global_batch_size"] is not None
        or config.loss_scale_factor is not None
    ):
        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.SUM
    else:
        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.MEAN

    metrics = {}

    # select fields and convert to padded tensor
    fields = ["response_mask", "old_log_probs", "advantages"]
    if "rollout_is_weights" in data:
        fields.append("rollout_is_weights")
    if "ref_log_prob" in data:
        fields.append("ref_log_prob")
    data = data.select(*fields).to_padded_tensor()

    response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)
    # compute policy loss
    old_log_prob = data["old_log_probs"]
    advantages = data["advantages"]
    rollout_is_weights = data.get("rollout_is_weights", None)

    loss_agg_mode = config.loss_agg_mode

    loss_mode = config.policy_loss.get("loss_mode", "vanilla")

    policy_loss_fn = get_policy_loss_fn(loss_mode)
    pg_loss, pg_metrics = policy_loss_fn(
        old_log_prob=old_log_prob,
        log_prob=log_prob,
        advantages=advantages,
        response_mask=response_mask,
        loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode,
        config=config,
        rollout_is_weights=rollout_is_weights,
    )

    # AggregationType.MEAN for pg metrics: assumes policy_loss_fn normalizes by local_bsz/local_tokens
    # Ex: in compute_policy_loss_vanilla, pg_metrics are pg_clipfrac, ppo_kl, pg_clipfrac_lower
    pg_metrics = Metric.from_dict(pg_metrics, aggregation=AggregationType.MEAN)

    metrics.update(pg_metrics)
    metrics["actor/pg_loss"] = Metric(value=pg_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)
    policy_loss = pg_loss

    # add entropy loss
    if entropy is not None:
        entropy_loss = agg_loss(
            loss_mat=entropy, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
        )
        entropy_coeff = config.entropy_coeff
        policy_loss -= entropy_coeff * entropy_loss
        metrics["actor/entropy_loss"] = Metric(value=entropy_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)

    # add kl loss
    if config.use_kl_loss:
        ref_log_prob = data["ref_log_prob"]
        # compute kl loss
        kld = kl_penalty(logprob=log_prob, ref_logprob=ref_log_prob, kl_penalty=config.kl_loss_type)
        kl_loss = agg_loss(
            loss_mat=kld, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=config.loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
        )

        policy_loss += kl_loss * config.kl_loss_coef
        metrics["kl_loss"] = Metric(value=kl_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)
        metrics["kl_coef"] = config.kl_loss_coef

    return policy_loss, metrics


def value_loss(config: CriticConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
    """value loss

    Args:
        config: CriticConfig
        model_output: model output from the model
        data: the input to the model
        dp_group: data paralle group

    Returns:
        value loss
    """
    vpreds = no_padding_2_padding(model_output["values"], data)  # (bsz, response_length)

    # Normalize the value loss over the global mini-batch (dp_size / batch_num_tokens /
    # global_batch_size) instead of the local micro-batch, so the accumulated critic gradient is
    # invariant to how the mini-batch is split into micro-batches (as the actor's ppo_loss does).
    dp_size = data["dp_size"]
    batch_num_tokens = data["batch_num_tokens"]
    global_batch_size = data["global_batch_size"]

    # When the loss is normalized over the global batch, each micro-batch contributes a partial sum,
    # so the loss metric must be aggregated with SUM to reflect the global-batch mean.
    if (
        dp_size > 1
        or batch_num_tokens is not None
        or global_batch_size is not None
        or config.loss_scale_factor is not None
    ):
        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.SUM
    else:
        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.MEAN

    # select fields and convert to padded tensor
    data = data.select("values", "returns", "response_mask").to_padded_tensor()
    values = data["values"]
    returns = data["returns"]
    response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)

    vf_loss, vf_clipfrac = compute_value_loss(
        vpreds=vpreds,
        values=values,
        returns=returns,
        response_mask=response_mask,
        cliprange_value=config.cliprange_value,
        loss_agg_mode=config.loss_agg_mode,
        dp_size=dp_size,
        batch_num_tokens=batch_num_tokens,
        global_batch_size=global_batch_size,
        loss_scale_factor=config.loss_scale_factor,
    )

    metrics = {
        "critic/vf_loss": Metric(value=vf_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation),
        "critic/vf_clipfrac": vf_clipfrac.detach().item(),
        "critic/vpred_mean": masked_mean(vpreds, response_mask).detach().item(),
    }

    return vf_loss, metrics

        token_level_scores (torch.Tensor): Token-level reward scores.
        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor): Log probabilities from current policy.
        ref_log_prob (torch.Tensor): Log probabilities from reference policy.
        kl_ratio (float): KL penalty coefficient.

    Returns:
        torch.Tensor: Token-level rewards with KL penalty applied.
    """
    kl = old_log_prob - ref_log_prob
    return token_level_scores - kl * kl_ratio


def agg_loss(
    loss_mat: torch.Tensor,
    loss_mask: torch.Tensor,
    loss_agg_mode: str,
    dp_size: int = 1,
    batch_num_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
    global_batch_size: Optional[int] = None,
    loss_scale_factor: Optional[int] = None,
):
    """
    Aggregate the loss across global batch to ensure the loss is invariant to fsdp/megatron parallelism.

    NOTE: The returned loss has different behaviors for different backend:
    - FSDP: the loss is directly used for backward.
    - Megatron: the loss should be scaled by `num_microbatches` and `cp_size` for pp schedule.

    Args:
        loss_mat: micro batch loss matrix, (bs, response_length)
        loss_mask: micro batch loss mask, (bs, response_length)
        loss_agg_mode: method to aggregate the loss matrix into a scalar
        dp_size: data parallel size
        batch_num_tokens: number of valid tokens in global batch
        global_batch_size: global batch size
        loss_scale_factor: scale factor for "seq-mean-token-sum-norm" mode. If None, uses loss_mask.shape[-1].
            Set this to a constant value to ensure consistent normalization throughout training.

    Returns:
        loss: `a scalar torch.Tensor`
            aggregated loss
    """
    if loss_agg_mode == "token-mean":
        if batch_num_tokens is None:
            if dp_size > 1:
                raise ValueError("(global) batch_num_tokens is required when dp_size > 1")
            batch_num_tokens = loss_mask.sum()
        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(loss_mat, loss_mask) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
    elif loss_agg_mode in ["seq-mean-token-sum", "seq-mean-token-sum-norm"]:
        seq_losses = torch.sum(loss_mat * loss_mask, dim=-1)  # token-sum
        seq_mask = (torch.sum(loss_mask, dim=-1) > 0).float()  # exclude fully masked sequences
        if global_batch_size is None:
            if dp_size > 1:
                raise ValueError("global_batch_size is required when dp_size > 1")
            global_batch_size = seq_mask.sum()
        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(seq_losses, seq_mask) / global_batch_size * dp_size  # seq-mean
        if loss_agg_mode == "seq-mean-token-sum-norm":
            if loss_scale_factor is None:
                horizon = loss_mask.shape[-1]
                loss_scale_factor = horizon
            loss /= loss_scale_factor
    elif loss_agg_mode == "seq-mean-token-mean":
        seq_mask = torch.sum(loss_mask, dim=-1)  # per-sequence token count
        seq_losses = torch.sum(loss_mat * loss_mask, dim=-1) / (seq_mask + 1e-8)  # token-mean
        seq_mask = (seq_mask > 0).float()  # exclude fully masked sequences
        if global_batch_size is None:
            if dp_size > 1:
                raise ValueError("global_batch_size is required when dp_size > 1")
            global_batch_size = seq_mask.sum()
        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(seq_losses, seq_mask) / global_batch_size * dp_size  # seq-mean
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid loss_agg_mode: {loss_agg_mode}")

    return loss

    contaminating the sum.

    Args:

        mask: Boolean or numeric mask tensor (same shape as values).

        axis: Dimension(s) along which to sum. None sums all elements.

    Returns:

    s = masked_sum(values, mask, axis)
    return s / (mask.sum(axis=axis) + 1e-8)

299	    def _build_messages(self, example: dict, key: str):
300	        """Replace multimodal placeholders in messages with structured content.
301	
302	        This is required by processor.apply_chat_template.
303	        - <image>: {"type": "image", "image": image} or {"type": "image", **image}
304	        - <video>: {"type": "video", "video": video} or {"type": "video", **video}
305	        - <audio>: {"type": "audio", "audio": audio} or {"type": "audio", **audio}
306	
307	        Args:
308	            example: Row dictionary from dataframe.
309	
310	        Returns:
311	            messages: List of messages with replaced placeholder.
312	        """
313	        messages: list = example[key]
314	        # When concatenating multimodal datasets, get will return None for samples without a modality column.
315	        images = example.get(self.image_key, None) or []
316	        videos = example.get(self.video_key, None) or []
317	        audios = example.get(self.audio_key, None) or []
318	
319	        image_offset, video_offset, audio_offset = 0, 0, 0
320	        for message in messages:
321	            if not images and not videos and not audios:
322	                continue
323	            assert self.processor is not None, "processor is needed to process multimodal data"
324	
325	            content = message["content"]
326	            if not isinstance(content, str):
327	                continue
328	
329	            content_list = []
330	            segments = re.split("(<image>|<video>|<audio>)", content)
331	            segments = [item for item in segments if item != ""]
332	            for segment in segments:
333	                if segment == "<image>":
334	                    assert image_offset < len(images), f"image_offset {image_offset} >= len(images) {len(images)}"
335	                    image = images[image_offset]
336	                    if isinstance(image, Image.Image):
337	                        image = image.convert("RGB")
338	                        content_list.append({"type": "image", "image": image})
339	                    elif isinstance(image, dict):
340	                        if "bytes" in image:
341	                            image["image"] = Image.open(BytesIO(image["bytes"]))
342	                        content_list.append({"type": "image", **image})
343	                    elif isinstance(image, str | os.PathLike):
344	                        content_list.append({"type": "image", "image": os.fspath(image)})
345	                    else:
346	                        raise TypeError(
347	                            f"image must be dict, PIL.Image, or path-like, unsupported image type: {type(image)}"
348	                        )
349	                    image_offset += 1
350	                elif segment == "<video>":
351	                    assert video_offset < len(videos), f"video_offset {video_offset} >= len(videos) {len(videos)}"
352	                    video = videos[video_offset]
353	                    if isinstance(video, dict):
354	                        content_list.append({"type": "video", **video})
355	                    elif isinstance(video, str | os.PathLike):
356	                        content_list.append({"type": "video", "video": os.fspath(video)})
357	                    elif isinstance(video, list):
358	                        video = [os.fspath(frame) if isinstance(frame, os.PathLike) else frame for frame in video]
359	                        content_list.append({"type": "video", "video": video})
360	                    else:
361	                        raise TypeError(
362	                            f"video must be dict, list, or path-like, unsupported video type: {type(video)}"
363	                        )
364	                    video_offset += 1
365	                elif segment == "<audio>":
366	                    assert audio_offset < len(audios), f"audio_offset {audio_offset} >= len(audios) {len(audios)}"
367	                    audio = audios[audio_offset]
368	                    if isinstance(audio, dict):
369	                        payload = dict(audio)
370	                        payload["type"] = "audio"
371	                        if "audio" not in payload and "audio_url" not in payload:
372	                            payload = {"type": "audio", "audio": audio}
373	                        content_list.append(payload)
374	                    else:
375	                        content_list.append({"type": "audio", "audio": audio})
376	                    audio_offset += 1
377	                else:
378	                    content_list.append({"type": "text", "text": segment})
379	            message["content"] = content_list
380	
381	        assert image_offset == len(images), f"image_offset {image_offset} != len(images) {len(images)}"
382	        assert video_offset == len(videos), f"video_offset {video_offset} != len(videos) {len(videos)}"
383	        assert audio_offset == len(audios), f"audio_offset {audio_offset} != len(audios) {len(audios)}"
384	        return messages

413	    @classmethod
414	    async def process_vision_info(
415	        cls,
416	        messages: list[dict],
417	        image_patch_size,
418	        config: DictConfig,
419	    ) -> tuple[list[Image.Image], list[tuple[torch.Tensor, dict]]]:
420	        """Extract images and videos from messages.
421	
422	        This method is called by AgentLoop (e.g SingleTurnAgentLoop) before apply_chat_template to
423	        the `raw_prompt` from dataset. User may customize RLHFDataset and override this method to
424	        support custom vision extraction.
425	
426	        >>> messages = kwargs["raw_prompt"]
427	        >>> images, videos = RLHFDataset.process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size)
428	        >>> videos, video_metadatas = zip(*videos)
429	        >>> raw_prompt = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False)
430	        >>> inputs = processor(text=[raw_prompt], images=images, videos=videos,
431	        ...                    video_metadata=video_metadatas, do_sample_frames=False)
432	
433	        Args:
434	            messages: List of messages from dataset `raw_prompt`.
435	            image_patch_size: Image patch size for processor.
436	            config: Config for dataset.
437	
438	        Returns:
439	            images: List of images.
440	            videos: List of videos, each video is a tuple of (video_tensor, video_metadata).
441	        """
442	        from qwen_vl_utils import process_vision_info
443	
444	        # When called from an AgentLoop, many trajectory coroutines share one
445	        # event loop. ``process_vision_info`` does synchronous PNG decode +
446	        # smart_resize (CPU-heavy); running it inline blocks the loop and starves
447	        # every sibling coroutine's socket I/O (manifests as connect timeouts /
448	        # zero-window stalls under concurrency). Offload to a thread: PIL/numpy
449	        # release the GIL during decode/resize, so the loop stays responsive and
450	        # the work parallelizes across threads. This method is ``async`` and only
451	        # ever awaited from an AgentLoop (which always has a running loop), so
452	        # ``get_running_loop()`` is safe here.
453	        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
454	        images, videos = await loop.run_in_executor(
455	            None,
456	            lambda: process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=image_patch_size, return_video_metadata=True),
457	        )
458	        return images, videos

460	    @classmethod
461	    def _extract_audio_info(cls, messages: list[dict]) -> list[Any]:
462	        audios = []
463	        for message in messages:
464	            content = message.get("content")
465	            if not isinstance(content, list):
466	                continue
467	            for item in content:
468	                if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("type") != "audio":
469	                    continue
470	                if "audio" in item:
471	                    audios.append(item["audio"])
472	                elif "audio_url" in item:
473	                    audios.append(item["audio_url"])
474	                else:
475	                    audios.append({k: v for k, v in item.items() if k != "type"})
476	        return audios or None

481	        messages: list[dict],
482	        image_patch_size,
483	        config: DictConfig,
484	    ) -> tuple[list[Image.Image], list[Any], list[Any]]:
485	        has_visual = any(
486	            isinstance(message.get("content"), list)
487	            and any(isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") in {"image", "video"} for item in message["content"])
488	            for message in messages

499	        return images, videos, audios

510	    def split(self, num_splits: int):
511	        """
512	        split the dataset into num_splits sub-datasets
513	        Args:
514	            num_splits: specified number of splits
515	        Returns:
516	            List[RLHFDataset]: list of RLHFDataset splits
517	        Raises:
518	            ValueError: if num_splits is not a positive integer
519	        """
520	        if not isinstance(num_splits, int) or num_splits <= 0:
521	            raise ValueError(f"num_splits must be a positive integer, got {num_splits}")
522	
523	        if not hasattr(self, "dataframe"):
524	            raise AttributeError(
525	                "dataframe not found in RLHFDataset\n"
526	                "reason: _read_files_and_tokenize() not called or Parquet file loading failed"
527	            )
528	        if self.dataframe is None:
529	            raise ValueError("RLHFDataset dataframe 为 None!")
530	
531	        total_samples = len(self.dataframe)
532	        print(f"total_samples: {total_samples}")
533	        if total_samples == 0:
534	            raise ValueError("Cannot split an empty dataset")
535	
536	        # Calculate effective sample count after dropping remainders if needed
537	        if total_samples % num_splits != 0:
538	            total_samples = total_samples - (total_samples % num_splits)
539	            logging.warning(f"Dropping {len(self.dataframe) % num_splits} samples, effective samples: {total_samples}")
540	
541	        split_size = total_samples // num_splits
542	        splits = []
543	
544	        for i in range(num_splits):
545	            start_idx = i * split_size
546	            end_idx = (i + 1) * split_size if i < num_splits - 1 else total_samples
547	
548	            split_dataframe = self.dataframe.select(range(start_idx, end_idx))
549	
550	            split_dataset = RLHFDataset(
551	                data_files=self.data_files,
552	                tokenizer=self.tokenizer,
553	                config=self.config,
554	                processor=self.processor,
555	                max_samples=self.max_samples,
556	            )
557	            split_dataset.dataframe = split_dataframe
558	            split_dataset.serialize_dataset = self.serialize_dataset
559	            split_dataset.original_data_files = self.original_data_files
560	
561	            splits.append(split_dataset)
562	
563	        return splits

567	    """Get RLHF dataset class.
568	
569	    Args:

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# GRPO | Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct | FSDP + vLLM, one GPU | GSM8K
# verls GSM8K GRPO quickstart scaled to a single GPU. Reward: verls built-in GSM8K
# rule (last "#### N" must equal the gold answer), scored by the DAPO reward manager
# with the overlong penalty disabled.
set -xeuo pipefail

W=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
cd "$W"

MODEL_PATH=${MODEL_PATH:-$W/models/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct}
TRAIN_FILE=${TRAIN_FILE:-$W/data/gsm8k/train.parquet}
VAL_FILE=${VAL_FILE:-$W/data/gsm8k/test.parquet}
LOG_DIR=${LOG_DIR:-$W/outputs/run}
NGPUS_PER_NODE=${NGPUS_PER_NODE:-1}
TOTAL_STEPS=${TOTAL_STEPS:-100}
TEST_FREQ=${TEST_FREQ:-10}
SEED=${SEED:-42}

TRAIN_BATCH_SIZE=128         # prompts per step
ROLLOUT_N=8                  # responses per prompt (GRPO group size)
PPO_MINI_BATCH_SIZE=32       # 4 optimizer steps per training step
MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH=512
MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH=512
ACTOR_LR=2e-6
KL_LOSS_COEF=0.001
ADAM_EPS=0.001               # AdamW eps raised from 1e-8: bf16 second-moment estimates underflow and give spiky updates

PROJECT_NAME=${PROJECT_NAME:-grpo_gsm8k}
EXPERIMENT_NAME=${EXPERIMENT_NAME:-qwen2_5_0_5b_gsm8k_grpo}

if [ ! -f "$MODEL_PATH/config.json" ]; then
    echo "model not found at $MODEL_PATH" >&2; exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "$TRAIN_FILE" ] || [ ! -f "$VAL_FILE" ]; then
    python3 examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k.py --local_dataset_path "$W/data/raw/gsm8k" --local_save_dir "$(dirname "$TRAIN_FILE")"
fi

mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
export PYTHONPATH="$W${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
export WANDB_MODE=${WANDB_MODE:-offline}
export WANDB_DIR=${WANDB_DIR:-$LOG_DIR}
export VERL_FILE_LOGGER_PATH="$LOG_DIR/metrics.jsonl"
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false

DATA=(
    algorithm.adv_estimator=grpo
    algorithm.use_kl_in_reward=False
    data.train_files="$TRAIN_FILE"
    data.val_files="$VAL_FILE"
    data.train_batch_size=$TRAIN_BATCH_SIZE
    data.max_prompt_length=$MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH
    data.max_response_length=$MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH
    data.filter_overlong_prompts=True
    data.truncation=error
    data.seed=$SEED
    data.dataloader_num_workers=0
)
MODEL=(
    actor_rollout_ref.model.path="$MODEL_PATH"
    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True
    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True
)
ACTOR=(
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=$ACTOR_LR
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.override_optimizer_config={eps:$ADAM_EPS}
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=$PPO_MINI_BATCH_SIZE
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=True
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu=24576
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=True
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=$KL_LOSS_COEF
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_type=low_var_kl
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.entropy_coeff=0
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.loss_agg_mode=token-mean
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.data_loader_seed=$SEED
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.param_offload=False
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.optimizer_offload=False
)
ROLLOUT=(
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=1
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.4
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=$ROLLOUT_N
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature=1.0
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.top_p=1.0
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.top_k=-1
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.seed=$SEED
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.agent.num_workers=1
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=24576
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.n=1
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.do_sample=False
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=24576
)
REWARD=(
    reward.reward_manager.name=dapo
    reward.num_workers=1
    +reward.reward_kwargs.overlong_buffer_cfg.enable=False
    +reward.reward_kwargs.overlong_buffer_cfg.len=128
    +reward.reward_kwargs.overlong_buffer_cfg.penalty_factor=1.0
    +reward.reward_kwargs.overlong_buffer_cfg.log=False
    +reward.reward_kwargs.max_resp_len=$MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH
)
TRAINER=(
    trainer.use_v1=False
    trainer.critic_warmup=0
    trainer.logger=[console,wandb,file]
    trainer.project_name=$PROJECT_NAME
    trainer.experiment_name=$EXPERIMENT_NAME
    trainer.n_gpus_per_node=$NGPUS_PER_NODE
    trainer.nnodes=1
    trainer.save_freq=-1
    trainer.test_freq=$TEST_FREQ
    trainer.val_before_train=True
    trainer.total_epochs=15
    trainer.total_training_steps=$TOTAL_STEPS
    trainer.resume_mode=disable
    trainer.rollout_data_dir="$LOG_DIR/rollouts"
    trainer.validation_data_dir="$LOG_DIR/val_generations"
)

# One GPU, a few CPUs: Ray must not size itself from the whole host.
RAY=(
    ray_kwargs.ray_init.num_cpus=4
    +ray_kwargs.ray_init.object_store_memory=6000000000
)

python3 -m verl.trainer.main_ppo \
    "${DATA[@]}" "${MODEL[@]}" "${ACTOR[@]}" "${ROLLOUT[@]}" "${REWARD[@]}" "${TRAINER[@]}" "${RAY[@]}" "$@" \
    2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/train.log"

47	        # For FSDP backend, the loss is directly used for backward; while for Megatron backend,
48	        # the loss should be scaled by `num_microbatches` for pp schedule.
49	        loss = -masked_sum(log_prob_flatten, loss_mask_flatten) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
50	    else:
51	        response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)
52	        loss = -masked_sum(log_prob, response_mask) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
53	
54	    return loss, {}

57	def ppo_loss(config: ActorConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
58	    """Computes ppo loss from model output (log_prob, entropy, values, etc. ) and old_log_probs from data."""
59	    log_prob = no_padding_2_padding(model_output["log_probs"], data)
60	    entropy = model_output.get("entropy", None)
61	    if entropy is not None:
62	        entropy = no_padding_2_padding(entropy, data)
63	
64	    # global batch info for loss aggregation
65	    config.global_batch_info["dp_size"] = data["dp_size"]
66	    config.global_batch_info["batch_num_tokens"] = data["batch_num_tokens"]
67	    config.global_batch_info["global_batch_size"] = data["global_batch_size"]
68	    config.global_batch_info["loss_scale_factor"] = config.loss_scale_factor
69	
70	    # assumes that if any of the global batch info is set, the policy_loss_fn will
71	    # normalize using dp_size/global_bsz/global_token; in this case, metric aggregation should be SUM
72	    # to reflect the mean loss over the global batch
73	    if (
74	        data["dp_size"] > 1
75	        or data["batch_num_tokens"] is not None
76	        or data["global_batch_size"] is not None
77	        or config.loss_scale_factor is not None
78	    ):
79	        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.SUM
80	    else:
81	        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.MEAN
82	
83	    metrics = {}
84	
85	    # select fields and convert to padded tensor
86	    fields = ["response_mask", "old_log_probs", "advantages"]
87	    if "rollout_is_weights" in data:
88	        fields.append("rollout_is_weights")
89	    if "ref_log_prob" in data:
90	        fields.append("ref_log_prob")
91	    data = data.select(*fields).to_padded_tensor()
92	
93	    response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)
94	    # compute policy loss
95	    old_log_prob = data["old_log_probs"]
96	    advantages = data["advantages"]
97	    rollout_is_weights = data.get("rollout_is_weights", None)
98	
99	    loss_agg_mode = config.loss_agg_mode
100	
101	    loss_mode = config.policy_loss.get("loss_mode", "vanilla")
102	
103	    policy_loss_fn = get_policy_loss_fn(loss_mode)
104	    pg_loss, pg_metrics = policy_loss_fn(
105	        old_log_prob=old_log_prob,
106	        log_prob=log_prob,
107	        advantages=advantages,
108	        response_mask=response_mask,
109	        loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode,
110	        config=config,
111	        rollout_is_weights=rollout_is_weights,
112	    )
113	
114	    # AggregationType.MEAN for pg metrics: assumes policy_loss_fn normalizes by local_bsz/local_tokens
115	    # Ex: in compute_policy_loss_vanilla, pg_metrics are pg_clipfrac, ppo_kl, pg_clipfrac_lower
116	    pg_metrics = Metric.from_dict(pg_metrics, aggregation=AggregationType.MEAN)
117	
118	    metrics.update(pg_metrics)
119	    metrics["actor/pg_loss"] = Metric(value=pg_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)
120	    policy_loss = pg_loss
121	
122	    # add entropy loss
123	    if entropy is not None:
124	        entropy_loss = agg_loss(
125	            loss_mat=entropy, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
126	        )
127	        entropy_coeff = config.entropy_coeff
128	        policy_loss -= entropy_coeff * entropy_loss
129	        metrics["actor/entropy_loss"] = Metric(value=entropy_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)
130	
131	    # add kl loss
132	    if config.use_kl_loss:
133	        ref_log_prob = data["ref_log_prob"]
134	        # compute kl loss
135	        kld = kl_penalty(logprob=log_prob, ref_logprob=ref_log_prob, kl_penalty=config.kl_loss_type)
136	        kl_loss = agg_loss(
137	            loss_mat=kld, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=config.loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
138	        )
139	
140	        policy_loss += kl_loss * config.kl_loss_coef
141	        metrics["kl_loss"] = Metric(value=kl_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)
142	        metrics["kl_coef"] = config.kl_loss_coef
143	
144	    return policy_loss, metrics
145

147	def value_loss(config: CriticConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
148	    """value loss
149	
150	    Args:
151	        config: CriticConfig
152	        model_output: model output from the model
153	        data: the input to the model
154	        dp_group: data paralle group
155	
156	    Returns:
157	        value loss
158	    """
159	    vpreds = no_padding_2_padding(model_output["values"], data)  # (bsz, response_length)
160	
161	    # Normalize the value loss over the global mini-batch (dp_size / batch_num_tokens /
162	    # global_batch_size) instead of the local micro-batch, so the accumulated critic gradient is
163	    # invariant to how the mini-batch is split into micro-batches (as the actor's ppo_loss does).
164	    dp_size = data["dp_size"]
165	    batch_num_tokens = data["batch_num_tokens"]
166	    global_batch_size = data["global_batch_size"]
167	
168	    # When the loss is normalized over the global batch, each micro-batch contributes a partial sum,
169	    # so the loss metric must be aggregated with SUM to reflect the global-batch mean.
170	    if (
171	        dp_size > 1
172	        or batch_num_tokens is not None
173	        or global_batch_size is not None
174	        or config.loss_scale_factor is not None
175	    ):
176	        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.SUM
177	    else:
178	        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.MEAN
179	
180	    # select fields and convert to padded tensor
181	    data = data.select("values", "returns", "response_mask").to_padded_tensor()
182	    values = data["values"]
183	    returns = data["returns"]
184	    response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)
185	
186	    vf_loss, vf_clipfrac = compute_value_loss(
187	        vpreds=vpreds,
188	        values=values,
189	        returns=returns,
190	        response_mask=response_mask,
191	        cliprange_value=config.cliprange_value,
192	        loss_agg_mode=config.loss_agg_mode,
193	        dp_size=dp_size,
194	        batch_num_tokens=batch_num_tokens,
195	        global_batch_size=global_batch_size,
196	        loss_scale_factor=config.loss_scale_factor,
197	    )
198	
199	    metrics = {
200	        "critic/vf_loss": Metric(value=vf_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation),
201	        "critic/vf_clipfrac": vf_clipfrac.detach().item(),
202	        "critic/vpred_mean": masked_mean(vpreds, response_mask).detach().item(),
203	    }
204	
205	    return vf_loss, metrics

153	class AdaptiveKLController:
154	    """
155	    Adaptive KL controller described in the paper:
156	    https://arxiv.org/pdf/1909.08593.pdf
157	    """
158	
159	    def __init__(self, init_kl_coef, target_kl, horizon):
160	        self.value = init_kl_coef
161	        self.target = target_kl
162	        self.horizon = horizon
163	
164	    def update(self, current_kl, n_steps):
165	        """Update the KL coefficient based on current KL divergence.
166	
167	        Args:
168	            current_kl (float): Current KL divergence value.
169	            n_steps (int): Number of steps taken.
170	        """
171	        target = self.target
172	        proportional_error = np.clip(current_kl / target - 1, -0.2, 0.2)
173	        mult = 1 + proportional_error * n_steps / self.horizon
174	        self.value *= mult
175

215	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GAE)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("gae")
216	def compute_gae_advantage_return(
217	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
218	    values: torch.Tensor,
219	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
220	    gamma: torch.Tensor,
221	    lam: torch.Tensor,
222	):
223	    """Adapted from https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/main/trl/trainer/ppo_trainer.py
224	
225	    Args:
226	        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
227	            shape is (bs, response_length)
228	        values: `(torch.Tensor)`
229	            shape is (bs, response_length)
230	        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
231	            shape is (bs, response_length). [EOS] mask. The token after [EOS] have mask zero.
232	        gamma is `(float)`
233	            discounted factor used in RL
234	        lam: `(float)`
235	            lambda value when computing Generalized Advantage Estimation (https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02438)
236	
237	    Returns:
238	        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
239	            shape: (bs, response_length)
240	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
241	            shape: (bs, response_length)
242	
243	    """
244	    with torch.no_grad():
245	        nextvalues = 0
246	        lastgaelam = 0
247	        advantages_reversed = []
248	        gen_len = token_level_rewards.shape[-1]
249	
250	        for t in reversed(range(gen_len)):
251	            delta = token_level_rewards[:, t] + gamma * nextvalues - values[:, t]
252	            lastgaelam_ = delta + gamma * lam * lastgaelam
253	
254	            # skip values and TD-error on observation tokens
255	            nextvalues = values[:, t] * response_mask[:, t] + (1 - response_mask[:, t]) * nextvalues
256	            lastgaelam = lastgaelam_ * response_mask[:, t] + (1 - response_mask[:, t]) * lastgaelam
257	
258	            advantages_reversed.append(lastgaelam)
259	        advantages = torch.stack(advantages_reversed[::-1], dim=1)
260	
261	        returns = advantages + values
262	        advantages = verl_F.masked_whiten(advantages, response_mask)
263	    return advantages, returns

267	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GRPO)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("grpo")
268	def compute_grpo_outcome_advantage(
269	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
270	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
271	    index: np.ndarray,
272	    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
273	    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
274	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
275	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
276	    """
277	    Compute advantage for GRPO, operating only on Outcome reward
278	    (with only one scalar reward for each response).
279	
280	    Args:
281	        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
282	            shape is (bs, response_length)
283	        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
284	            shape is (bs, response_length)
285	        index: `(np.ndarray)`
286	            index array for grouping
287	        epsilon: `(float)`
288	            small value to avoid division by zero
289	        norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: `(bool)`
290	            whether to scale the GRPO advantage
291	        config: `(Optional[AlgoConfig])`
292	            algorithm configuration object
293	
294	    Note:
295	        If norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo is True, the advantage is scaled by the std, as in the original GRPO.
296	        If False, the advantage is not scaled, as in Dr.GRPO (https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783).
297	
298	    Returns:
299	        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
300	            shape is (bs, response_length)
301	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
302	            shape is (bs, response_length)
303	    """
304	    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
305	
306	    id2score = defaultdict(list)
307	    id2mean = {}
308	    id2std = {}
309	
310	    with torch.no_grad():
311	        bsz = scores.shape[0]
312	        for i in range(bsz):
313	            id2score[index[i]].append(scores[i])
314	        for idx in id2score:
315	            if len(id2score[idx]) == 1:
316	                id2mean[idx] = torch.tensor(0.0)
317	                id2std[idx] = torch.tensor(1.0)
318	            elif len(id2score[idx]) > 1:
319	                scores_tensor = torch.stack(id2score[idx])
320	                id2mean[idx] = torch.mean(scores_tensor)
321	                id2std[idx] = torch.std(scores_tensor)
322	            else:
323	                raise ValueError(f"no score in prompt index: {idx}")
324	        for i in range(bsz):
325	            if norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo:
326	                scores[i] = (scores[i] - id2mean[index[i]]) / (id2std[index[i]] + epsilon)
327	            else:
328	                scores[i] = scores[i] - id2mean[index[i]]
329	        scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
330	
331	    return scores, scores
332

334	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GRPO_VECTORIZED)
335	def compute_grpo_vectorized_outcome_advantage(
336	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
337	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
338	    index: np.ndarray,
339	    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
340	    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
341	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
342	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
343	    """
344	    Vectorized GRPO（outcome-only）:
345	      For each group g:
346	      a_i = \\frac{r_i - \\mu_g}{\\sigma_g} (or without dividing by \\sigma_g),
347	      then broadcast the scalar across the token dimension (multiplied by response_mask).。
348	    """
349	    with torch.no_grad():
350	        scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
351	        g = as_torch_index(index, device=scores.device)
352	        mean_g, std_g, _ = group_mean_std(scores, g, eps=0.0, device=scores.device)
353	        if norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo:
354	            scalars = (scores - mean_g[g]) / (std_g[g] + epsilon)
355	        else:
356	            scalars = scores - mean_g[g]
357	        advantages = scalars.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
358	        return advantages, advantages

361	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GDPO)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("gdpo")
362	def compute_gdpo_outcome_advantage(
363	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
364	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
365	    index: np.ndarray,
366	    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
367	    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
368	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
369	    non_tensor_batch: Optional[dict] = None,
370	    batch: Optional[dict] = None,
371	    **kwargs,
372	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
373	    """
374	    GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization.
375	
376	    Instead of summing all reward dimensions first (like GRPO), GDPO normalizes
377	    each reward dimension independently within each group before aggregation.
378	    This prevents a dominant reward signal from drowning out weaker ones.
379	
380	    Mathematical formulation:
381	        Step 1 – Group-wise decoupled normalization (via GRPO per dimension):
382	            For each reward dimension k, within each group g:
383	            A_k = (r_k - μ_group(r_k)) / (σ_group(r_k) + ε)
384	
385	        Step 2 – Weighted aggregation:
386	            A_sum = Σ_k w_k · A_k
387	
388	        Step 3 – Batch-level normalization (via masked_whiten):
389	            A_final = whiten(A_sum, response_mask)
390	
391	    Args:
392	        token_level_rewards: (bs, response_length) – standard token-level rewards.
393	            Used as fallback when per-dimension rewards are not provided.
394	        response_mask: (bs, response_length)
395	        index: (bs,) – group id per sample (from ``uid``).
396	        epsilon: Numerical stability constant.
397	        norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: Whether to normalize by std in GRPO.
398	        config: Algorithm configuration (optional).
399	        non_tensor_batch: Non-tensor batch data containing per-dimension reward scores.
400	        batch: Batch data containing prompts, attention_mask, etc.
401	
402	    Note:
403	        Ref GDPO (https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242).
404	
405	    Returns:
406	        advantages: (bs, response_length)
407	        returns: (bs, response_length) – same as advantages (outcome-only).
408	    """
409	    score_list = None
410	    reward_weights = None
411	
412	    if config is not None and non_tensor_batch is not None and batch is not None:
413	        gdpo_reward_keys = config.get("gdpo_reward_keys", None)
414	        assert gdpo_reward_keys, (
415	            "GDPO requires 'algorithm.gdpo_reward_keys' listing the individual reward "
416	            "component keys returned by compute_score (e.g. ['format_reward', 'accuracy_reward'])."
417	        )
418	        device = token_level_rewards.device
419	        prompt_length = batch["prompts"].size(1)
420	        valid_response_length = batch["attention_mask"][:, prompt_length:].sum(dim=1) - 1
421	
422	        score_list = []
423	        for key in gdpo_reward_keys:
424	            assert key in non_tensor_batch, (
425	                f"GDPO reward key '{key}' not found in non_tensor_batch. "
426	                f"Available keys: {list(non_tensor_batch.keys())}. "
427	                f"Make sure your compute_score returns a dict containing '{key}'."
428	            )
429	            comp = non_tensor_batch[key]
430	            rm_score = torch.tensor(np.asarray(comp, dtype=np.float32), device=device)
431	            rm_scores = torch.zeros_like(response_mask, dtype=torch.float32)
432	            rm_scores[torch.arange(rm_scores.size(0), device=device), valid_response_length] = rm_score
433	            score_list.append(rm_scores)
434	
435	        gdpo_weights = config.get("gdpo_reward_weights", None)
436	        if gdpo_weights is not None:
437	            reward_weights = list(gdpo_weights)
438	
439	    if score_list is None:
440	        score_list = [token_level_rewards]
441	
442	    num_scores = len(score_list)
443	
444	    if reward_weights is not None:
445	        weights = torch.tensor(reward_weights, dtype=torch.float32, device=token_level_rewards.device)
446	    else:
447	        weights = torch.ones(num_scores, dtype=torch.float32, device=token_level_rewards.device)
448	
449	    new_advantage = None
450	
451	    for i in range(num_scores):
452	        normalized_score, _ = compute_grpo_outcome_advantage(
453	            token_level_rewards=score_list[i],
454	            response_mask=response_mask,
455	            index=index,
456	            epsilon=epsilon,
457	            norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo=norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo,
458	            config=config,
459	        )
460	
461	        if new_advantage is None:
462	            new_advantage = weights[i] * normalized_score
463	        else:
464	            new_advantage += weights[i] * normalized_score
465	
466	    advantages = verl_F.masked_whiten(new_advantage, response_mask) * response_mask
467	
468	    return advantages, advantages
